title: AI Unboxing Video Maker for Online Sellers | AIVideosUGC
description: Create an AI unboxing video from one product photo: hands open the box, fold back the tissue, and reveal your item. Sized for TikTok and Shorts. Make yours now.
h1: Make an AI Unboxing Video of Your Product
lead: Show hands opening a box and lifting your product out, starting from one product photo. Describe the box and tissue you really ship with.

steps.d: Show the full item clearly. Describe the packaging and reveal in the next step.
Name the wrapping and what comes out first, such as a kraft box, cream tissue and a candle.
Describe only packaging you use, then review the result before sharing.

faq.q: Do I need a photo of my packaging?
faq.a: No. Upload the product itself and describe the box, wrapping and inserts you use.

faq.q: Will my logo appear on the box?
faq.a: Don't count on it. Logos and printed words can come out slightly wrong in AI video, so describe the box by color and finish, then add your logo on top in CapCut. Requests that use logos or trademarks you don't own may be refused.

faq.q: What length works for an unboxing video?
faq.a: Choose 6 seconds for a quick reveal, 10 to open the box and lift the item, or 15 to show several pieces. Use 9:16 for TikTok or Shorts and 1:1 for a product page.

faq.q: Can I make an unboxing video for a gift set or bundle?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a photo of the set and list what's inside, such as “three candles and a matchbox in a ribbon-tied box.” A few items usually come out cleaner than a crowded box.

faq.q: What should be visible in an unboxing shot?
faq.a: Keep the hands, package opening and the product reveal fully inside the frame.

faq.q: Can I use a plain package?
faq.a: Yes. Unbranded packaging keeps attention on the product and the reveal sequence.

faq.q: Can I keep accessories in the box?
faq.a: Yes. Name the lead item first, then list the accessories and reveal them one at a time. This keeps the final arrangement readable instead of hiding the product in a crowded box.

faq.q: What should the final unboxing frame show?
faq.a: Hold the complete product, box opening, and included pieces inside the frame. Add a gift note, price, or campaign headline later in your editor so the package stays clear.

overview.p: An unboxing clip follows a simple reveal: open the outer package, move aside one layer of wrapping, and show the item. Describe the materials and order you use so the preview stays close to the package customers receive.

steps.sourceAlt: Your product: a plain candle jar shown upright with its full shape visible.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a bright home counter, adult hands open the plain kraft box, fold back tissue and lift the candle jar once. End with the jar centered beside the open box. Soft window light, calm unboxing style. Overhead medium framing with one slow push-in. Sound: lid lift, paper rustle and glass set-down; no music.

picker.title: Browse unboxing formats
picker.lead: Pick the reveal format that matches the parcel you actually ship. Creator first looks keep the item near the lens while the presenter names what arrived; ASMR unboxings make paper, hinges, trays, and fabric audible; gentle reveals slow down the lift of a gift or baby item; package reveals show the box, insert, and hero product in one readable arrangement. Keep hands, package edges, and the full product inside the frame. Plain packaging is safer when printed words are not available, and campaign text belongs in your editor after download.

uses.h: Show what arrives in the box
uses.d: An unboxing clip can answer a delivery question before checkout: what will arrive, and how is it protected? Start with the outer package, open one layer at a time, and hold the hero item still at the end. Use a vertical frame for a creator first look or a square frame for a product page. Keep tissue, inserts, and accessories in a tidy order so the viewer can count the pieces. If the set is large, reveal one item first and place the rest in a row rather than hiding the lead product.

uses.h: Add a reveal to a product page
uses.d: A reveal becomes more trustworthy when it matches the package you use. Describe kraft board, a mailer, a tray, or fabric wrap by its real finish, and avoid invented logos or claims. A soft sound cue can make the opening feel tactile, but the product must remain the visual focus. Review color, size, and included pieces against your fulfillment box before posting. If the box or insert changes for a seasonal run, make a new version instead of reusing a clip that shows a different delivery.

visual.overview: An unboxing video makes the delivery moment easy to follow: package opens, tissue moves, and the product rises into view. Upload a clear product photo, describe the box material and insert, and name the lead item before optional accessories. Use a [product launch video](/occasions/product-launch) for a reveal, a [holiday campaign](/occasions/holidays) for a gift set, and [cinematic product videos](/ai-video-generation/cinematic-video) when the final hold needs extra atmosphere. Choose 6, 10, or 15 seconds. Use a 9:16 vertical frame for [TikTok](/platforms/tiktok-ads) and Shorts, or a 1:1 square frame beside a store description.
